settings.text:
• The backyard mystery. Out for an hour, back with leaves in the fur and no explanation.

settings.title: How it works
settings.step1_text: Hold the button: the camera switches on and starts recording.
settings.step2_text: Slide the mount onto their collar so the lens sits under the chin, facing forward.
settings.step3_text: When they're back, take it off and watch the video on your phone.

settings.title: Good to know before you buy
settings.text:
• Let your pet get used to the collar and camera at home first, for a few minutes at a time.
  • Use it on a well-fitting collar, never on a choke or prong collar. Two fingers should fit under the collar.
  • Don't leave your pet unsupervised with it for long periods, and take it off for sleep.
  • Not a GPS tracker. It films, it doesn't show where they are live.
  • No official waterproof rating: keep it out of pools, baths and heavy rain.

settings.title: From real pets
settings.note: Brand new store. Reviews from our customers will appear here, word for word.

settings.a: The mount clips onto most standard dog and cat collars. For small cats and puppies, make sure the camera isn't too heavy for them and the collar fits well.

settings.q: How do I watch the videos?
settings.a: Video saves to the microSD card in the camera. After the adventure, plug the included card reader into your phone and watch, no app or Wi-Fi needed. The screen on the back lets you check the shot before the walk.
It's small and light and sits under the chin like a tag. Introduce it slowly at home and take it off if your pet seems bothered.
One camera for one pet. Two or three cost less per camera: one for each pet, or one to keep and the others as gifts.
